name: Variety Show
description: Variety Show is coming up!! Don't miss it.. Mark your calendar!! Come watch your friends: Sing, Dance, Act and more!!

name: Hicklebee's Book Fair
description: The Hicklebee's Book Fair is coming to Los Alamitos! This year, we're delighted to continue our partnership with our local children's bookstore, Hicklebee's, who will generously provide the books for our fair.

name: Multicultural Fair
description: This year's Multicultural Fair will take place. A beloved tradition at this school, we once again invite you to share your culture with us, whether it's helping with your country's booth (or starting one if it isn't represented yet!), fashion show, or with a group cultural performance.

name: Yearbook Order Deadline
description: Order your 2025–26 Yearbook today and save all the memories. Last day to order: 4/20 — but don't wait until the last minute! We won't have extras on hand if you forget to order.

name: ELA Testing
description: 3rd-5th grade students will be taking the ELA CAT/PT assessments from 4/20-4/24.

name: Math Testing
description: 3rd-5th grade students will be taking the Math CAT/PT assessments from 4/27-5/1.

name: Green Team Sign Up
description: Students interested in joining the Green Team should fill out the interest survey. The team will focus on learning how to take care of the environment.

name: Valentine's Day Party
description: PARENTS: Bring 1 Valentine's card for each of the 22 students in the class. Leave the 'To:' section blank for easier pass out. Please keep goodies and prizes small this year.

name: Hidden Villa Field Trip
description: PARENTS: Return the permission slip by next Monday! This allows the kids to interact with the animals and taste the edible plants. Bring a disposable, home-packed lunch.

name: Last Day of School
description: PARENTS: Students can wear Aloha/Hawaiian shirts. This is a minimum day with dismissal at 12:06pm.

name: Memorial Day
description: No school.

name: Spring Pictures
description: Students can wear free dress.

name: Minimum Days
description: Students will be dismissed at 12:06pm.

name: Dress Rehearsal for Variety Show
description: Dress Rehearsal for those participating in the Variety Show

name: Nowruz (Iranian New Year) Staff Luncheon
description: Please join us as we treat our staff to a delicious luncheon to celebrate the upcoming Iranian New Year and the first day of spring!

name: Pioneer High School Athletics 2026 Crab Feed
description: Come hungry (and thirsty!) to the Pioneer High School Athletics 2026 Crab Feed. It's an all-you-can-eat + all-you-can-drink night that keeps the fun (and the cracking!) going on.

name: Yearbook 5th Grade Baby Photos Deadline
description: 5th grade parents — start gathering those adorable baby photos for the 5th Grade Baby Pages! They are due by March 31st!

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) during the school year.

name: Yearbook Photo Deadline
description: We are looking for photos from PTA events this year! If you have photos from the following events and would like them to be shared in the yearbook, please upload to these Google Drive Folders: Spirit Days, Dandy Day, Bubblefest, Science-o-rama, Dances. Please only upload 1-2 photos per event!

name: Castillero Middle School PTA Board
description: Castillero PTA is looking for incoming 6th grade parents to serve on the board. Castillero PTA funds and/ or runs events and programs like school dances, carnival, spirit wear, teacher and staff appreciation, and teacher grants.

name: 2026-27 PTA Board Recruitment
description: We are looking for members of our Los Alamitos community to join our PTA Executive Board for 2026-27 school year! Serving on the PTA Executive Board offers a behind-the-scenes look at how our fundraising efforts work and provides a direct way to support and strengthen our school community.

name: Schools of Tomorrow Community Alert
description: A group of local parents is urging the community to visit www.LosAlamitosElementary.com to read their breakdown of the issue and take urgent action before March 26. Their goal is to keep Los Alamitos boundaries AS IS and reject this new addition proposed.
